effect.x-y: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the target’s current Speed compared to the user, given by `1 + 25 * target Speed / user Speed`, capped at 150.
effect.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the target’s current Speed compared to the user, given by `1 + 25 * target Speed / user Speed`, capped at 150.

short_effect.x-y: Power raises when the user has lower Speed, up to a maximum of 150.
short_effect.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Power raises when the user has lower Speed, up to a maximum of 150.

flavor_text.x-y: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user compared to the target, the greater the move’s power.
flavor_text.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user compared to the target, the greater the move’s power.
